item.tib: chos spyod thaMs cad kyi man ngag mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyud
item.skt: ar+ba d+ha ma tsar ya u pa 'de' sha a b+hi sa ma ya tan tra
item.coloph: chos spyod thaMs cad kyi man ngag mngon rtogs pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud rdzogs s+ho//_//kra shis par gyur cig/
item.colophTitle: chos spyod thaMs cad kyi man ngag mngon rtogs pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud
item.note: This text is not found in mainstream sources; however, a commentary on the respective tantra is found in the Bstan 'gyur, cf. rKTs-T3805.
